title: OpenAI expands CoreWeave deal by up to $6.5B

sources.quote: Subject to any termination described below and satisfaction of delivery and availability of service requirements, OpenAI has committed to pay the Company up to approximately $6.5 billion through May 31, 2031 under the Order Form.
The agreement announced today brings the total contract value with OpenAI up to approximately $22.4 billion.

explain: A third OpenAI order with CoreWeave worth up to $6.5 billion through May 2031, bringing OpenAI's total CoreWeave commitments to about $22.4 billion.
